nodes.description: 1024x1024 app icon for socialio/КонтентГров. Dark teal/green rounded-square background with a centered white glyph composed of three concentric upward-arching curves (wifi/signal-wave motif) topped by a small upward-pointing chevron. The stacked arcs evoke broadcasting, content distribution, or social reach. The color palette (deep green + white) signals growth, trust, and clarity. Clean, minimal, platform-ready style suitable for Meta App Review submission requirements.
